description: Adds users to a group as participants, moderators or admins (up to 100 per list); listing a current member under another role changes their role. Failures aren't reported per user: check with cometchat_list_group_members.

admins.description: UIDs to add as admins (full control of the group)

confirm.description: Set true only after the user has explicitly agreed to this change. Without it, nothing happens and you get a summary to show them.

moderators.description: UIDs to add as moderators (can remove members and messages)

participants.description: UIDs to add as ordinary members

name: cometchat_add_group_members
title: Add group members
